title: Interlaced loops of the Chellah minaret (Rabat)
subtitle: Chellah mosque minaret, Rabat

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s CM014 drawing. It is the design of the Alhambra Museum loops, built the same way: the straight bands pass where a circle of radius one half, or its mirror image, crosses the diagonal. The drawing gives no steps.
construction.changes: The compass operations, step order and named crossings are our reconstruction. Wichmann’s colours follow Castéra’s plate of the minaret; no photo of the minaret was available to check the lines.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data15/CM014: Minaret of Chellah Mosque, Rabat
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing, coloured after J.-M. Castéra’s Arabesques (page 103, the Chellah minaret). He lists the same repeat in the Alhambra Museum (RE3559), at San Juan de los Reyes in Toledo, on a stucco ceiling in the Bardo, Tunis, and on Moroccan zellige. The construction is ours.

given.A: The centre of an eight-pointed star between four loops.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. These lines make the square cell, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
Draw a straight line through A and C. It crosses the line from O to K1 at H. Draw a horizontal line through H. It crosses the vertical line through O at E.
Draw a circle with centre O through E. It crosses the line from O to K1 at F. Draw a circle with centre H through F. It crosses the line from O to K1 again at J.
Draw a vertical line through F. Draw a vertical line through J. Draw a line through E parallel to line AC.
Turn the three lines of the last step round O by 90°, three times.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the bands. Each band makes a square loop with a notch in every side. The loops link with their neighbours.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square cell side by side. Each loop weaves over and under its four neighbours.
